title: Cincin di Poket Hujung
subject: the dawn cleaner of a Klang snooker hall who finds an engagement ring in a corner pocket and puts up a notice, and the woman who comes to claim it asks him to keep it there
caption: 1990s Malay unplugged acoustic pop-rock, live-room band recording. Steel-string acoustic guitar fingerpicking a rolling pattern, nylon guitar adding a second melody line, soft upright piano chords, brushed snare and kick drum with a light cajon, fretless bass guitar. Live-room unplugged sound with gentle reverb, no studio polish. Male baritone lead, warm and conversational, mid register. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 78 BPM, C major. Reflective, quietly warm, wistful mood. No electronic drums, no synthesizer pads, no autotune, no rap, no heavy distortion, no dance beat.
lyrics:
[Intro - fingerpicked acoustic guitar, soft piano]

[Verse 1]
Subuh di Klang, dewan masih gelap
Aku sapu habuk, aku lap kain hijau
Di poket hujung meja nombor lapan
Ada sesuatu berkilat, kecil dan sejuk

[Pre-Chorus]
Sebentuk cincin, tak ada nama
Aku letak atas kaunter, aku tampal kertas

[Chorus]
Cincin di poket hujung, siapa punya
Tiga minggu aku tunggu, tak ada yang datang
Cincin di poket hujung, aku simpan dulu
Kalau dia balik, aku tahu mukanya

[Verse 2]
Petang Khamis, seorang perempuan masuk
Dia baca kertas, dia diam lama
Dia kata, itu bukan hak aku lagi
Cincin tu dari orang yang dah pergi

[Pre-Chorus]
Dia tanya, boleh tak simpan di situ
Biar dalam poket, biar bola lalu atasnya

[Chorus]
Cincin di poket hujung, aku pulang semula
Aku sapu dewan, aku lap kain hijau
Cincin di poket hujung, biar duduk di situ
Sampai ada tangan lain yang berani

[Bridge - guitar and piano only]
Setiap subuh aku jenguk, ia masih ada
Aku tak ambil, aku tak ganggu

[Outro - fingerpicked guitar, piano fade]
Meja nombor lapan, poket hujung
Biar ia tunggu, biar ia tunggu
